At the same time, you probably don’t need perfect forensic proof of every historical claim if you can secure clear, enforceable commitments going forward and make sure the carve-outs don’t swallow the uptime guarantee. One pragmatic path is to decide whether the combination of a well-defined SLA scope, a realistic liability structure, and the summary evidence they’re offering is enough, and then concentrate your negotiation energy on any residual gaps that could genuinely harm your operations.
